beats.text: That tiny hole in your window isn't a defect. It's keeping you safe.
Your window is three layers, not one.
Outside air is thin. The cabin is pressurized. So the window gets pushed outward, hard.
The outer layer takes that push.
The tiny hole lets cabin air into the gap, so the middle layer feels no push. It's the spare.
It also lets moisture escape, so the window doesn't fog up.
If the outer layer failed, the middle one would hold. Now you know.
